messages.text: I see the Harlo L. being advertised.  I put a deposit in to get one, when will I be able to complete the purchase?
Read the mystery miner early access page
Handed to the team · No Loto release / purchase date in the catalog or product facts; will not guess.

I found your $20 Harlo L. Early Bird Deposit, Raland. It's order Shop···· from October 30, and it's paid.

I don't have a date for when the full Loto purchase opens yet. Nothing in our listings gives one, so I won't guess.

I've asked the team when deposit holders can finish buying. Someone will pick up your ticket and send the answer to (email hidden)
On your site it says 3 days 19 hours?

That countdown is the right thing to watch, Raland. From right now it ends around Friday late morning Eastern.

I can't see the countdown from my side, so I can't confirm it's when deposit holders get to finish buying, or how you'll be let in. I've added that to the question the team already has. They'll email the answer to (email hidden)

Your $20 deposit on Shop···· is paid and on file.
ok, so hurry up and wait, I have learned that with your company, none of my questions over the last 3 weeks have been answered here, discord, or pm.
Handed to the team · Repeat customer, several unanswered questions stacked up across 3 weeks. I can't

You're right, Raland, and I'm sorry. I can see the questions that were never answered: the price match and the two firmware cases from Oct 31, the H15 firmware question you asked on the 10th and again on the 14th, the Helium Labs invite, and now the Loto.

That's three weeks of being told someone would get back to you, and nobody did. I've sent all of them to the team together as one request, and said you need a single reply from a person that answers every one. It'll come to (email hidden)
Do you have an update on the T40 ship out?

Yes, Raland, there's news. The 40Ts have left the factory. As of today our shipment status page shows them on their way to our warehouses, including the one in Tennessee. None have arrived yet.

(address hidden), Miner D. and Power K. (Shop····) are booked to ship together from Tennessee once the units are in. I can't confirm yet whether your unit is in this first shipment, so I won't give you a date. You'll get tracking by email as soon as yours ships.

You can follow the shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
